data_fields.name: drop_limit
data_fields.donor_constant: drop limit per group; 0 with minimum 0 means scan-once mode

data_fields.name: entry_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: percent per item entry (weight in weighted mode)

data_fields.name: entry_copies
data_fields.donor_constant: multiplier; extra copies roll their own chance

data_fields.name: table_repeat_multiplier
data_fields.donor_constant: multiplier x GlobalLootMultiplier repeats per table entry

data_fields.name: bypass_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: 100 or more in any eligible entry passes the gate for the group

data_fields.name: npc_level_band
data_fields.donor_constant: npc_min_level / npc_max_level per entry (0 means no bound)

best_idea: Make a drop table a set of data rows with a per-table gate, a weighted pick, a guaranteed minimum and a per-copy roll, rolled on the server when a kill is verified.
decision_why: Take the table shape as zone data, but roll at the verified kill on the server, not at NPC spawn as the donor does.
acceptance: 10,000 seeded kills on a table of three items (chances 60, 30, 10; drop limit 1; minimum 0): about 74.8% of kills drop one item and of those about 60/30/10 percent are the three items.
